description: Connect approved GitLab.com or self-managed projects with a personal access token to synchronize repository files and inspect code, commits, merge requests, and issues through read-only assistant tools.

assistant_guidance.summary: Use GitLab tools to inspect approved projects, repository files, and time-bounded engineering activity.
when_to_use: The user asks for current information from an approved GitLab project.
The user asks to inspect or search code in an approved project.
The user asks for an engineering activity report over a time window.

topics.summary: Read a file or search code inside an approved GitLab project.
topics.details: Use the namespace/project value selected by the Connection. Do not invent a project outside the Connection allowlist. Use a branch, tag, or commit ref when the user specifies one.

topics.summary: Collect compact commits, merge requests, and issues across approved projects in one Tool call.
topics.details: For a time-bounded activity report, call gitlab_activity_summary once with all relevant approved projects. The Plugin makes fixed read-only GitLab REST API requests in Python, rechecks Connection scope, filters the exact time window, and returns bounded evidence. Treat partial errors and possibly_truncated as coverage limitations instead of issuing per-project retries.

datasource.description: Synchronize repository files from an explicitly authorized GitLab.com or self-managed project into a LensNode workspace. Issues and merge requests remain available through read-only tools and are not synchronized as datasource content.

endpoint.title: GitLab endpoint
endpoint.description: Public or self-managed root HTTP(S) GitLab endpoint.

secret_value.title: Personal access token
secret_value.description: A write-only token with read_api and read_repository access to the approved projects.

projects.title: Allowed projects
projects.description: Explicit namespace/project values this connection may access.

branch.title: Branch
branch.description: Optional branch, tag, or commit ref shared by all projects.

tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from an approved GitLab project.
Search code within an approved GitLab project and return bounded file metadata.

Get compact commits, merge requests, and issues in one ISO-8601 time window across approved GitLab projects. Use this once for engineering reports. The Plugin makes fixed read-only GitLab REST API requests in Python and returns bounded projections.
